newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA SPURTS AHEAD ON SALOMON VIEW.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA SPURTS AHEAD ON SALOMON VIEW.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telcommunications group Nokia Oy rose sharply in sturdy volume on Wednesday after a favourable comment from Salomon Brothers and in response to a major order earlier, brokers said.
At 1409/1109 GMT Nokia traded at 441.00 markka, up 16.80 markka or almost four percent, a new all-time high.
"In general, these recommendations (from U.S. investment banks) have had an impact," one broker said.
Salomon said it had started rival Ericsson with a "buy," but preferred Nokia on a one-year view, saying Ericsson was at least 15 percent more expensive than Nokia.
Nokia was already strong, boosted after it earlier said it had won a significant A$200 million GSM expansion order in Australia, but news of the Salomon comment fired more gains.
